title: Move Copilot review engine into AL-Go
summary: AL-Go gains a built-in Copilot pull request review. A new SetupBCQuality action installs and filters the BCQuality plugin, and a new ReviewAgent action runs the review and posts comments. Generated Per Tenant Extension and AppSource App templates get a two-workflow integration, configured through new BCQuality and CodeReviewAgent settings.
key_points: New ReviewAgent action runs in four phases (context, prepare, generate, post). Review generation is read-only, and a separate job with write permissions publishes the results.
New SetupBCQuality action is the only place BCQuality is installed. It filters the plugin by layers, skills and knowledge rules.
Per Tenant Extension and AppSource App templates get CopilotPRReview and CopilotPRReviewRunner workflows. The runner starts through workflow_run and reads trusted settings from the base repository.
New BCQuality and CodeReviewAgent settings split AL knowledge selection from review orchestration policy.
Review is bound to the validated PR head SHA, and untrusted PR code is never used as workflow configuration or review infrastructure.
